reviews.observation: A centered lyric on a bright field is progressively occluded by colorful round-ended vertical bars entering from upper and lower edges around 70.73-70.97. Behind the bars, a pink framed character composition and large vertical glyphs become visible around 71.0. Bars clear progressively; glyphs move and reduce to a narrow vertical phrase around 71.70-71.87 while the illustrated frame remains.
reviews.correction: This narrow interval supports a staggered foreground bar wipe and large-to-small vertical typography reflow. The broad candidate label rearranging text panels does not describe the observed transition adequately; review it without deleting original raw evidence.
reviews.production_proposal: Use independent foreground occluders bridging adjacent scenes and independent text-group transforms. A whole-frame crossfade cannot express the relationship.

reviews.observation: A cyan instrument collage and centered white text are replaced by a right-to-left pink wipe around 69.0-69.46. A subsequent yellow wipe around 69.83-70.17 introduces a small tilted media-window graphic containing text. Brush-like elements pass behind it. Its text changes before the yellow-to-orange wipe around 70.96-71.13. Around 71.33-71.46 the window moves upward relative to the text, which is visible below it.
reviews.correction: Retain the tilted lyric-card relationship but add full-frame wipe order, internal text change and subsequent text/window separation. The field is yellow during most of the card hold and orange later; color alone is not a separate form.
reviews.production_proposal: Represent a text-to-window relationship that can change over time; separate background wipe, window transform, interior text and background strokes. Parenting/detaching or shared transform tracks are implementation options, not facts about the original production.
